title: Ye Fatima bhi hai Zehra bhi hai
body:
Ye Fatima bhi hai Zehra bhi hai
yaa raaziya yaa marziya yaa tahera yaa sayyada 2
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh fakhre aamina sarmaayae rasool bhi hai
yeh fatema bhi hai zahra bhi hai butool bhi hai 3
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek sawaal ka behtar jawaab zinda hai
sadaaqato ka mukammal nisaab zinda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bahaare baaghe risaalat ma aab zinda hai
khuda ke bando khuda ki kitab zinda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bayaan azmatei khaatoone qaaenat suno
mubahele ki zubaan se khuda ki baat suno
<<DIVIDER>>
kaha jo bizato minni toh ho gaya maalum
dile rasul ki surat hai fatema maasum
<<DIVIDER>>
kamaale ilm se aisa bana diya maqsoom
naseeb ho gaye 11 imamato k nuzool
<<DIVIDER>>
waqaar binte nabi me na kuch kami aaye
khuda ke ghar mei isi waaste ali aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ne shukr se mazdooriyo me din kaate
nabi ki beti ne chakki me khusk jao peese
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ne baago me paani diya jihaad kiye
nabi ki beti ne faako me bhar diye sajde
<<DIVIDER>>
jihaad nafs ka maidaa ali ke haath raha
kamaale sabro riza faatima k saath raha
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ek chota sa ghar poori kaaenat ka dil
woh ek hujra imamat ke noor ki manzil
<<DIVIDER>>
woh baamodar jinhe sajda kare mahe kaamil
woh ek nakhl ke saaye me khuld ki mehfil
<<DIVIDER>>
adab ke saath balandi ka har nishaan jhuke
jaha kaneez ke rube pe aasmaan jhuke
<<DIVIDER>>
banaame faatema ummat ki betiya jaage
nigaahe akl se raftaare zindagi dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
baraaye ghairate dil apne aap se puche
kise milegi jagah fatema ki mehfil me
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda kare woh tamashaae rozgaar naa ho
rasule paak ki beti se sharmsaar na ho
<<DIVIDER>>
dhua tanoor se uttha to saaelo k liye
khameer ho gaya aata musafiro ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
sukoone qalb ka samaan bekaso k liye
gizaaye sabro riza apne kamsino k liye
<<DIVIDER>>
isi makaam pe khairul amal ke jalwe hai
yahi woh har hai jaha inqilaab palte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke chehrae aqdas pe ambiya ka jalaal
wujud fatema zahra pe mustafa ka jamaal
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke dam se jaha me tajalliyo k nehal
mataye fatema zahra hasan husain se laal
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ne masjide kufa me zakhm khaaya hai
zamaane waalo ne zahra ko bhi rulaaya hai
author: Shadman Raza
